Account.description: Allowlisted metadata only; never contains cookies, origins, token hashes, credential paths or raw credentials.

AccountPatch.description: Optional expectedCredentialVersion and expectedStateVersion must be supplied together. A mismatch returns VERSION_CONFLICT (409).

AuditEntry.description: 30-day retention; never store raw tokens, cookie/storage state or request credential bodies.

accountId.description: Opaque stable identifier; never use the filesystem index as an account ID.

auditId.description: Opaque stable identifier; never use the filesystem index as an account ID.

items.description: Opaque stable identifier; never use the filesystem index as an account ID.

Cookie.description: Playwright storage-state cookie; sensitive and accepted/exported only as credentials.

oneOf.description: Legacy JSON-encoded Credentials object; decoded content is subject to identical schema and byte limits.

CredentialReplaceInput.description: Legacy raw storageState remains accepted and verifies by default. Versioned clients wrap it and supply both expected versions; verify:false saves credentials and enables without model verification. With proxy and verify:false, preserve enabled/disabled state while committing both credentials and proxy.

proxy.description: Optional private account proxy URL committed with credentials. Omission preserves the current proxy.

Credentials.description: External import accepts only accountName, cookies and origins. Control fields such as disabled/expired/accountId/index and versions are rejected. Maximum 1 MiB UTF-8 serialized credentials.

ErrorCode.description: HTTP mappings and task-only codes are documented in x-error-catalog.

items.description: Opaque stable identifier; never use the filesystem index as an account ID.

ImportRequest.description: Commit each new account enabled by default. verify:false skips model verification; omitted or true verifies independently after commit. Reject duplicate email; do not replace. clientRef must be nonempty, at most 128 characters and unique within this batch. Validate clientRef and model before admission; return HTTP 400 and do not enqueue on invalid input.

clientRef.description: Nonempty caller reference, unique within this import batch; duplicates are rejected at admission without creating a task.

proxy.description: Optional private account proxy URL. Omission retains the default egress.

model.description: Validate at admission; invalid input returns 400 without creating a task.

token.description: Shown once. mgmt_ prefix plus base64url encoding of 32 random bytes; only SHA-256 is persisted.

id.description: Opaque stable identifier; never use the filesystem index as an account ID.
Opaque stable identifier; never use the filesystem index as an account ID.

Readiness.description: Independent browser, enabled accounts, system maintenance and usable generation v2 connection checks. Local account maintenance may remain ready through another eligible account. Admission saturation does not make readiness false.

Task.description: Durable for 30 days. Queued resumes on restart; running becomes interrupted without replay. Cancellation does not undo committed state.

createdByKeyId.description: Opaque stable identifier; never use the filesystem index as an account ID.

items.description: Opaque stable identifier; never use the filesystem index as an account ID.

taskId.description: Opaque stable identifier; never use the filesystem index as an account ID.

TaskAccepted.description: On idempotent replay return the original admission response and taskId, even if that task has since completed; GET the task for current status.

taskId.description: Opaque stable identifier; never use the filesystem index as an account ID.

accountId.description: Opaque stable identifier; never use the filesystem index as an account ID.

model.description: Validate at admission; invalid input returns 400 without creating a task.

UploadOnlyResult.description: Successful verify:false import or replace. Uploaded is not model verification evidence.

UploadReceipt.description: Immutable evidence that this task item committed credentials. Independent of verification and enabled state; survives failed, cancelled or interrupted tasks. Import records the initial enabled credential write; replace records only the actual replacement after candidate verification. Absence means no receipt evidence, including legacy tasks, not proof that no upload occurred. Versions are captured at that write, never filled from a later account read.

proxyApplied.description: True only when this credential commit also applied the requested account proxy; no authentication is returned.

VerificationResult.description: Original closed Aitoapi verification schema, retained for explicit compatibility reference. Go task results reference PlaygroundVerificationResult instead.

PlaygroundVerificationResult.description: Go-only closed Playground schema. A pinned account, usable visible output, upstream 2xx, observed finish and current captured versions are required for model_verified. A connection probe is not model evidence.

loginPasswordSync.description: Supports separate write-only Google login password synchronization.

SettingsPatch.description: Explicit Go settings only. Phase-one capability settingsWrite:false returns INVALID_STATE before mutation; no fake persistence or Aitoapi-only flags.

VerificationChannels.description: Omitted means Build. Both channels normalize to build,playground. No fallback. Explicit null and empty arrays are invalid.

ChannelVerificationResult.description: Pinned Build/Playground evidence. Single-channel top-level transport fields mirror the child; aggregate actualChannel/requestId are absent. Completed child evidence persists on failure/cancellation/restart. See verification-channels.md.

lastOperationId.description: Empty until the first password operation; otherwise its UUID.
Empty until the first password operation; otherwise its UUID.

AccountId.description: Stable accountId, not numeric index; archived IDs can be restored.
AccountId.name: id

IdempotencyKey.description: Required on mutating task submissions. Scoped by authenticated key ID and canonical method/path/body. Same content returns original task/admission; changed content yields 409. Retained 30 days with tasks.
IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key

KeyId.description: Management key identifier, never the token.
KeyId.name: id

RequestedWith.description: Required on console management-key writes; session must come from console-password login. Cross-site/same-site Fetch-Metadata is rejected. If Origin is supplied it must exactly equal this request origin.
RequestedWith.name: X-Requested-With

ConsoleSession.description: Console-password session; session.authMethod must equal console_password. Model-key login and legacy sessions require console password re-login.
ConsoleSession.name: connect.sid

ManagementBearer.description: Management token only. No console session or model API key fallback. SHA-256 hash persisted; plaintext once.
